judged_text: `ensure_embeddable` now issues a `lower(host)` table lookup on every embed request where the old path read the in-memory cached site setting, and no index on `host` backs the non-sargable predicate. Every embedded-page view (comments/count endpoints) pays a DB round-trip plus a sequential scan that was previously a memory read; on a high-traffic forum with many embedded iframes this is a per-request query added to a hot path for a lookup that changes only when an admin edits hosts.

adjudication.rationale: The diff changes the embed hot path from an in-memory SiteSetting check to a DB lookup: `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` now calls `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(request.referer)` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb), which calls `record_for_host` and executes `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first` (app/models/embeddable_host.rb). The migration creating `embeddable_hosts` adds no index on `host` (db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb). Using `lower(host)` also prevents use of a plain index, so the advisory about an added per-request DB round trip and likely sequential scan is grounded. This is a performance/architecture concern rather than a functional defect.
